verdict.rationale: Bento captures every span over OpenTelemetry with a span-tree view, auto-captures LLM calls at the SDK level (including a Google ADK integration), and offers `bento.track_ai` to wrap any LLM or tool call manually. It also reports cost per run out of the box, which implies token accounting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that captured spans record inputs, outputs, latency, and token counts as fields; independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
